_comment: Bundle budgets for the Mochiichao web build. Single source of truth for tests/check-bundle-budget.mjs and docs/ci-budgets-2026-10-27.md. Baselines measured 2026-10-27: (a) live gh-pages single bundle index-r-Trvo3i.js = 2,266,589 bytes raw, 518,474 bytes gzip (curl); (b) full local production build dist/ = 1,465 JS files, 2,969,102 bytes raw, 976,249 bytes gzip (vite build --base=./ from main 08648398). The single-bundle numbers and the dist totals are different scopes — budgets cover both. Tightening a budget is a Mars decision, not a silent edit.
